event.description: Remove fixed-length EOS row and unused final position by checkpoint surgery
event.proposal: Family: token representation. Current retained frontier is 3,408 parameters at 99.180000%, a +0.180000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 4 prior attempts in this family. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0015, exact PAD-row excision at 3,408 parameters and 99.18% official accuracy; the most recent failed result is attempt-0014, a fresh-optimization failure for the same PAD-free semantics with no official score. Hypothesis: because every answer is exactly 11 digits, EOS and the twelfth decoding step are unnecessary; dropping the final EOS vocabulary row, generating exactly 11 greedy tokens, and cropping the now-unused final positional row preserves the retained model's first 11 digit logits while yielding 3,376 parameters. This parameterization-preserving fixed-length compression is more informative than the nearest untested BOS removal because it requires no positional shift or learned-state change and directly tests only the redundant termination symbol.
